summary: Iter41: mobile landing, Home gate, mobile layout, partner photo, QR dialog and P5 regression. Found and fixed 1 critical backend bug: POST /api/partner/foto returned 500 for every request (TypeError: partner_record() missing 'database' arg). After the fix all requested checks pass.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: called partner_record(user) without db, so every valid upload returned 500 'Erro interno' and the avatar never reached GET /api/public/coupon/CLUB-10. Changed it to partner_record(user, db).

ui_bugs.issue: Toasts sit at top-right and cover the mobile header, including mobile-menu-toggle. Example: the 'Bem-vindo' toast after login. While the toast is hovered or expanded, the hamburger cannot be clicked. Suggest position='top-center' with an offset, or bottom on mobile.

issues: The 'R-Conekta' wordmark next to the logo is light blue/white on a near-white background, so contrast is very low. When scrolled, the header looks transparent and content shows through behind it.
The 'Valor da conta (€)' input looks vertically squashed (low height) compared with the email input below it.
The email placeholder is cut off ('Email para receber o recibo (opcion').

action_items: Review the partner_photo fix in routes_payments.py (partner_record(user, db)) and grep for any other partner_record calls missing the db arg
Move Sonner toasts so they don't cover the mobile header/hamburger
Improve contrast of the landing header wordmark; consider a solid header background
Fix the height of the 'Valor da conta' input on the public coupon page on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: routes_payments.partner_photo: replaces the avatar without an audit() entry, unlike the IBAN change
The PhotoIn regex accepts any base64 data and does not check that the image actually decodes. Acceptable, since the max_length of 260k caps the size.
seed_data_creation: The partner 'Parceiro Exemplo' avatar was set to a test image (pink 64x64 square JPEG via the UI). Rate-limit keys login:* were cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 390x844: landing testids (simulator, step-1..4, CTAs) present; at ticket 100 and 50 clients the partner value = 4000,00 EUR, and switching currency shows R$ 4.000,00; scrollWidth is 390 on /, /login, /admin, /admin/gestao, /admin/pagamentos, /parceiro, /influencer, /c/CLUB-10; mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-sidebar; a logged-in admin on / is redirected to /admin; the QR dialog in the Gestão Campanhas tab shows the canvas, and PNG download cupao-CLUB-10.png works with no JS errors; /api/public/p5/config returns enabled with eur true; test_p5_rules + test_p5_pt_settlement pass 11/11.
rca of the issue: partner_access.partner_record has the signature (user, database), but the new partner_photo endpoint called it with only one argument, which raised a TypeError and a 500 response.
